title: Frogs
text:
Many frogs live near ponds and rice fields. A frog has long back legs, so it can jump far. Its skin is wet and smooth.

A mother frog lays lots of eggs in the water. A tadpole comes out of each egg. Tadpoles swim and grow. They grow legs, and their tails get smaller and smaller. Then they are little frogs!

Frogs eat flies, worms and other small animals. A frog catches a fly with its long, sticky tongue.
